commits.message:
feat(docs): tabs that would wrap become a foldable list of files by folder (rich-demos-k78j.gjt)

An unseen one-row copy of the tabs, at the card's width, says when they no
longer fit; then they are a vertical tablist beside the editor, grouped by
folder, folded by a toggle, and folded from the start on a card narrower
than 720px. Tabs follow the grouped order in both layouts and the arrow
keys of both orientations move along it.

fix(docs): card failures stay in view while editing (rich-demos-k78j.rzr) (#374)

* fix(docs): a card's failures stand under its code and stay in view while it is (rich-demos-k78j.rzr)

cardCore hands its failures out on their own (failures()), and both card
views place them directly under the editor; the block is sticky to the
window's bottom so a tall editor or output never pushes it out of sight.

Also repairs two example-card e2e assertions that 1cv broke on master: a
crash's failure now folds its stack under the sentence, so they read the
summary.

* fix(docs): failures really stick, and a live card runs while the card is on screen (rich-demos-k78j.rzr review)

overflow: clip on cards, so sticky has the window to stick to; a live
program runs while its card is on screen, so an edit made above an
off-screen terminal still runs and fails where the reader is; failure
nodes keyed by source; editor scroll margin keeps the cursor line above
the stuck bar; the folded report is capped.

* fix(docs): the editor's scroll margin is only what the failures cover (rich-demos-k78j.rzr review)
